The Tormore depot was founded in 1878. Visitors often remark on the old stone stairway. The Tormore depot can hold 3,310 visitors. The manager of the Tormore depot is Kasimir. Visitors often remark on the old stone stairway.

The Lunby granary was founded in 1972. The Lunby granary can hold 4,090 visitors. The east wing is closed for repairs. The manager of the Lunby granary is Ysolde. The building was repainted after the last storm.

Visitors often remark on the old stone stairway. The manager of the Yorwell archive is Ivo. The Yorwell archive can hold 4,680 visitors. A small café near the entrance serves local bread. The Yorwell archive was founded in 1933.
